environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB listener on port 443 forwards all traffic to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional managed rule groups attached to the ALB. Application runs as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user with gunicorn. SQLite database stored at /var/app/data/users.db with file permissions 0644.

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTPS:443 -> HTTP:8080, no WAF association
config.instance: t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
